visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed photo with an overlaid heading, subtitle and CTA buttons (page hero and join banner)
visualCharacteristics.layout: background image fills the block; text sits bottom-left over a dark gradient scrim

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading (H1 for the page hero, H2 elsewhere), subtitle paragraph, CTA links (bold = primary button, italic = secondary), optional location/caption link

cells: Heading, subheading paragraph, CTA links (bold = primary, italic = secondary)

usage: Page-top hero and in-page join/promotional banners that put text over a photo.
reuseGuidance: Use for any photo-background banner with heading and CTAs. For text beside an image use columns; for a split hero use the base hero block.
